response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced full-stack/backend engineer with a broad multi-language background (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, Java), but he lacks the core requirements for this role: no substantive C++ development experience (only a brief 6-month stint on C/C++ components in 2014-2015), no Windows-platform development, no SQL Server/Oracle experience, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure. His career has been almost entirely web/backend/product engineering rather than financial systems.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse software engineering experience with strong seniority level
Demonstrated craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing) valuable in critical systems
Strong communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source leadership
concerns: Only ~6 months of C++ exposure (2014-2015), far short of the 5-10 years required
No evidence of Windows platform development; background is primarily Linux/web-based
No SQL Server/Oracle experience and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain knowledge

key_factors.factor: No capital markets/fixed income domain experience
